cases.sentence: Народ Израиля тронулся в путь из Елима, и на ___ второго месяца после ухода из Египта пришел в пустыню Син, что между Елимом и Синаем.
cases.explain: «пятнадцатый день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

cases.sentence: Народ Израиля тронулся в путь из Елима, и на пятнадцатый день ___ после ухода из Египта пришел в пустыню Син, что между Елимом и Синаем.
cases.explain: «второго месяца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

cases.sentence: На ___ пусть они соберут вдвое больше, чем в прочие дни, и заготовят это впрок.
cases.explain: «шестой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.”

cases.sentence: На шестой день пусть они соберут вдвое больше, чем в ___, и заготовят это впрок.
cases.explain: «прочие дни» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.”

cases.sentence: Когда роса сошла, на поверхности пустыни показались ___, похожие на иней.
cases.explain: «тонкие хлопья» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.

cases.sentence: На ___ они собрали в два раза больше — по два омера на человека — и вожди народа пришли и доложили об этом Моисею.
cases.explain: «шестой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

cases.sentence: Вы будете собирать хлопья шесть дней, но на ___, в субботу, ничего не будет.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none.”

cases.sentence: Некоторые из народа вышли собирать в ___, но ничего не нашли.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.

cases.sentence: Запомните: Господь дал вам субботу, и поэтому в ___ дает вам хлеб на два дня.
cases.explain: «шестой день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Behold, because Yahweh has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”

cases.sentence: Пусть в ___ каждый остается там, где он есть.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Behold, because Yahweh has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”

cases.sentence: И в ___ народ пребывал в покое.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: So the people rested on the seventh day.

cases.sentence: Она была белой, как ___, а на вкус — как медовое печенье.
cases.explain: «кориандровое семя» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”, and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.
